reproducible_evidence.reason: The dynamic report includes the active evidence and full candidate diff hashes; its stdout hash cannot be embedded in the same evidence without recursion.
reproducible_evidence.final_registration_rule: The command must pass at the final clean HEAD and mechanically verify this evidence hash, the implementation commit ancestry/artifacts, LF checkout equivalence, all self-tests, full baseline scope, and raw blob secret scan.

audit_finding_closures.P1_architect_candidate_binding: Architect lease/report/replay all bind the projected REPLAN candidate, active lease, real Git commit, HEAD, base and context; detached candidates and reused producer identities are rejected.
audit_finding_closures.P1_combined_tail_head_recovery: Tail normalization accepts only a semantically valid local-ahead prefix of the external head, then resume performs CAS reconciliation; the combined no-newline/local-ahead interruption is injected.
audit_finding_closures.P1_auditor_owned_task_lifecycle: A VIEW::AUDITOR Task in READY obtains the single writer capability for its exact fixture/evidence scope, produces IMPLEMENTED evidence, then requires independent Auditor and Reviewer identities before VERIFIED.
audit_finding_closures.P1_slice_gate_lifecycle: Slice Gate Runner has a dedicated read-only slice lease, immutable complete Task evidence context, trusted PASS/FAIL event, expiration recovery and no Task/Gate mutation.
audit_finding_closures.P1_lf_reproducibility: G07 hashed text artifacts are fixed to LF in .gitattributes and the evidence command compares worktree bytes with committed Git blobs under core.autocrlf=true.
audit_finding_closures.P1_active_evidence_and_implementation_co: The evidence command validates the active evidence path/hash/payload, G07_A_COMMIT existence and ancestry, and every registered artifact byte hash at that implementation commit.
audit_finding_closures.P1_external_head_provider_boundary: The external head executable must be outside the role-writable workspace and is revalidated for path, type, links and SHA-256 immediately before every spawn.

known_limitations: The production platform trust, external monotonic head and trusted receipt inbox providers remain UNAVAILABLE in G07-A. Non-empty event use and product execution therefore hard-stop until the environment registers all providers.
Self-tests use ephemeral in-memory platform/head authorities only under internal test authority; no private signing key or monotonic head is stored in the workspace.
This evidence proves the control-plane implementation only. It does not approve G07 or authorize any product Task.
